c74object.name: evi.crossover.allpass~
c74object.digest: Allpass filter for aligning audio bands using evieve crossover filters
c74object.description:
evi.crossover.allpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_crossover_allpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.crossover.allpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Multiband Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters require alpass alignment. This filter gives access to the same filters used in all the evieve crossover filters, in case a custom summing method is wished for.

inlet.description: This should be fed from the 'High Frequency Cutoff' of a multiband crossover filter split to achieve correct alignment.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: 0=1-pole allpass filter, 1=2-pole allpass filter. 1-pole allpass filters are for aligning one band of a 2-pole crossover filter. 2-pole allpass filters are for aligning one band of a 4-pole crossover filter.

c74object.discussion: Of course evi.crossover.allpass~ is also just a very useful allpass filter away from this crossover business :-)
